purpose: CPU scaling subset selected for operational throughput (>=24 SDPD) and useful parallel-efficiency curves.

strong_cpu_80x80.notes: p1 median is 26.9 SDPD and is reused as the measured reference; no new p1 run is submitted. p128 is the single deliberate low-work endpoint.

strong_cpu_240x160.notes: p1 (~12.2 SDPD) and p2 (~23.4 SDPD) are excluded by throughput. p4, p8, p16 and p32 are excluded by the four-hour limit: p32 remained only 45-50% complete after three hours. p64 is the smallest viable point and the efficiency reference.

weak_cpu.notes: Retain the original 10x10 km per compute-rank tile sequence and all real-ICON-supported shapes.

reuse.already_submitted_and_retained: All selected p64-p384 tasks are already in Slurm; retain their queue priority rather than duplicate submission.
